blocks.text: Miklat Recovery Society offers gender-specific care that caters exclusively to men who are dealing with addiction issues. The program’s mission is to assist these men in escaping the cycle of addiction and to provide them with an environment in which they can begin their healing process. The dedicated team of professionals at Miklat seeks to create a climate of emotional and spiritual security that allows clients to rediscover themselves and their sense of purpose. Located in the beautiful region of British Columbia’s Sunshine Coast, the program offers a ten-bed home that is both intimate and welcoming. Clients can take advantage of nature hikes, fishing excursions, and other outdoor activities on weekends.

blocks.text: Miklat Recovery Society offers a range of life skills training that encompasses all aspects of daily living. The program places particular emphasis on cultivating healthy habits, maintaining personal hygiene, navigating household duties, and participating in group therapy. Clients at Miklat can take advantage of a range of evidence-based treatment modalities, including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), and music therapy. The program also offers access to 12 Step meetings and peer-based therapeutic groups, as well as workshops on relapse prevention and anger management. The team of qualified counselors will provide individualized care as they guide clients through the recovery process.

blocks.text: Miklat Recovery Society offers a haven of hope and purpose for men who are struggling with addiction. Our program offers a safe and secure environment in which clients can repair the damage that addiction has wrought. In addition to providing intensive counseling and therapy, we also help clients integrate healthy habits and practices into their daily lives. This includes everything from preparing balanced, nutritious meals to exploring spirituality and attending 12 Step meetings. By helping clients cultivate a sense of purpose and rediscover their passions, we provide an environment in which they can begin to imagine a fulfilling life that is free from addiction.

blocks.text: Miklat Recovery Society is an addiction rehab center designed to offer refuge and support to men struggling with drug and alcohol addiction. As a non-profit registered charity, Miklat Recovery Society provides cost-effective residential programs that include counseling, peer groups, life skills, anger management, and professional drug and alcohol counseling. The experienced addiction treatment staff at Miklat is made up of individuals who have worked in the field of addictions counseling and treatment, which includes those who have overcome addiction themselves.

centre.about_html:
Miklat Recovery Society offers gender-specific care that caters exclusively to men who are dealing with addiction issues. The program’s mission is to assist these men in escaping the cycle of addiction and to provide them with an environment in which they can begin their healing process. The dedicated team of professionals at Miklat seeks to create a climate of emotional and spiritual security that allows clients to rediscover themselves and their sense of purpose. Located in the beautiful region of British Columbia’s Sunshine Coast, the program offers a ten-bed home that is both intimate and welcoming. Clients can take advantage of nature hikes, fishing excursions, and other outdoor activities on weekends.

Life Skills Training

Miklat Recovery Society offers a range of life skills training that encompasses all aspects of daily living. The program places particular emphasis on cultivating healthy habits, maintaining personal hygiene, navigating household duties, and participating in group therapy. Clients at Miklat can take advantage of a range of evidence-based treatment modalities, including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), and music therapy. The program also offers access to 12 Step meetings and peer-based therapeutic groups, as well as workshops on relapse prevention and anger management. The team of qualified counselors will provide individualized care as they guide clients through the recovery process.

Purpose and Hope

Miklat Recovery Society offers a haven of hope and purpose for men who are struggling with addiction. Our program offers a safe and secure environment in which clients can repair the damage that addiction has wrought. In addition to providing intensive counseling and therapy, we also help clients integrate healthy habits and practices into their daily lives. This includes everything from preparing balanced, nutritious meals to exploring spirituality and attending 12 Step meetings. By helping clients cultivate a sense of purpose and rediscover their passions, we provide an environment in which they can begin to imagine a fulfilling life that is free from addiction.

Pricing Information

Miklat Recovery Society is committed to keeping non-insured costs as low as possible. Clients are welcome to use their insurance to offset the cost of treatment. The program costs $3,000 per month, with a maximum stay of 90 days. For those who choose to participate in the full 90-day program, the cost is $12,000. 




Miklat Recovery Society - Center Overview

Miklat Recovery Society is an addiction rehab center designed to offer refuge and support to men struggling with drug and alcohol addiction. As a non-profit registered charity, Miklat Recovery Society provides cost-effective residential programs that include counseling, peer groups, life skills, anger management, and professional drug and alcohol counseling. The experienced addiction treatment staff at Miklat is made up of individuals who have worked in the field of addictions counseling and treatment, which includes those who have overcome addiction themselves.

Miklat Recovery Society’s mission is to provide a nurturing environment for their clients to flourish and become active members of society. This is accomplished through supporting their clients through their journey in and out of residential treatment. The program has been designed to foster growth, with a research-based residential care, a high level of clinical counseling, trauma-informed therapy, evidence-based practices, structured programming, one-on-one counseling, and opioid agonist therapy. Members of Miklat Recovery Society can also participate in hiking, swimming, fishing, and other outdoor activities. The services provided by Miklat Recovery Society have been designed with abstinence in mind, which is important in giving their clients the best chance to succeed.

raw_html:
Miklat Recovery Society offers gender-specific care that caters exclusively to men who are dealing with addiction issues. The program’s mission is to assist these men in escaping the cycle of addiction and to provide them with an environment in which they can begin their healing process. The dedicated team of professionals at Miklat seeks to create a climate of emotional and spiritual security that allows clients to rediscover themselves and their sense of purpose. Located in the beautiful region of British Columbia’s Sunshine Coast, the program offers a ten-bed home that is both intimate and welcoming. Clients can take advantage of nature hikes, fishing excursions, and other outdoor activities on weekends.

Life Skills Training

Miklat Recovery Society offers a range of life skills training that encompasses all aspects of daily living. The program places particular emphasis on cultivating healthy habits, maintaining personal hygiene, navigating household duties, and participating in group therapy. Clients at Miklat can take advantage of a range of evidence-based treatment modalities, including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), and music therapy. The program also offers access to 12 Step meetings and peer-based therapeutic groups, as well as workshops on relapse prevention and anger management. The team of qualified counselors will provide individualized care as they guide clients through the recovery process.

Purpose and Hope

Miklat Recovery Society offers a haven of hope and purpose for men who are struggling with addiction. Our program offers a safe and secure environment in which clients can repair the damage that addiction has wrought. In addition to providing intensive counseling and therapy, we also help clients integrate healthy habits and practices into their daily lives. This includes everything from preparing balanced, nutritious meals to exploring spirituality and attending 12 Step meetings. By helping clients cultivate a sense of purpose and rediscover their passions, we provide an environment in which they can begin to imagine a fulfilling life that is free from addiction.

Pricing Information

Miklat Recovery Society is committed to keeping non-insured costs as low as possible. Clients are welcome to use their insurance to offset the cost of treatment. The program costs $3,000 per month, with a maximum stay of 90 days. For those who choose to participate in the full 90-day program, the cost is $12,000. 




Miklat Recovery Society - Center Overview

Miklat Recovery Society is an addiction rehab center designed to offer refuge and support to men struggling with drug and alcohol addiction. As a non-profit registered charity, Miklat Recovery Society provides cost-effective residential programs that include counseling, peer groups, life skills, anger management, and professional drug and alcohol counseling. The experienced addiction treatment staff at Miklat is made up of individuals who have worked in the field of addictions counseling and treatment, which includes those who have overcome addiction themselves.

Miklat Recovery Society’s mission is to provide a nurturing environment for their clients to flourish and become active members of society. This is accomplished through supporting their clients through their journey in and out of residential treatment. The program has been designed to foster growth, with a research-based residential care, a high level of clinical counseling, trauma-informed therapy, evidence-based practices, structured programming, one-on-one counseling, and opioid agonist therapy. Members of Miklat Recovery Society can also participate in hiking, swimming, fishing, and other outdoor activities. The services provided by Miklat Recovery Society have been designed with abstinence in mind, which is important in giving their clients the best chance to succeed.
